evidence.quote: The last ferry moves from 22:40 to 21:55 on weekdays from November
The late sailing carried under ten passengers a night

observations.why: Settled future change stated as fact with specific times and dates; the passenger count is a realis past. Window-of-change framing reads as future-focused, but modality is actual rather than possible.

evidence.quote: The weekend timetable stays as it is
Friday and Saturday late sailings still fill

observations.why: Describes the current, unchanged weekend state as actual, with named days and sailings.
